title: Baki-Dou’s New Season Brings Several Real-Life Political Figures to Anime
content: Baki-Dou: The Invincible Samurai has returned for its second season, landing on Netflix earlier this week to continue the arrival of heavy-hitter Musashi Miyamoto. With the wandering samurai making his way through the cast, the anime adaptation took a break from the current storyline to focus on some surprising…
author: ComicBook

title: Chainsaw Man Anime Gets Smartphone Game With Opening Animation by MAPPA
content: The " MAPPA 15th Anniversary Lineup Reveal" livestream event on Friday revealed that the Chainsaw Man anime is getting a smartphone game. The game will feature an opening animated sequence by MAPPA featuring Maximum The Hormone 's song "All the Lynch!! All the Mince!!" MAPPA is streaming the animated sequence.
author: ANN

title: JIMOTO SAIKO Gets Anime Adaptation by Studio MAPPA
content: MAPPA has announced an anime adaptation of JIMOTO SAIKO (working title), based on the manga by creator usagi. The series will stream exclusively on Netflix worldwide, with a teaser visual and trailer unveiled during the studio’s 15th anniversary presentation.
author: Anime Corner

title: Yoroi-Shinden Samurai Troopers Anime's 2nd Part Previews Ending Theme in New Video
content: The staff for Yoroi-Shinden Samurai Troopers , the new sequel anime of the Yoroiden Samurai Troopers series, revealed a second promotional video on Friday for the anime's second cours (quarter of a year). The video previews the ending theme song.
author: ANN

title: Yamishibai: Japanese Ghost Stories Anime Gets 17th Season on July 12
content: The staff of the Yamishibai: Japanese Ghost Stories television anime announced on Friday that the anime is getting a 17th season that will air on the TV Tokyo channel starting on July 12.
author: ANN

title: New Ahare! Meisaku-kun Anime's Latest Video Unveils Theme Song, July 5 Debut
content: The staff for the new Ahare! Meisaku-kun television anime presented a promotional video and key visual on Friday. The video announces and previews the theme song "Nonsense Nonsense" by the band Frederic , and it also announces the new anime's July 5 premiere.
author: ANN

title: 5 Years Later, Tokyo Ghoul Creator’s Masterpiece Confirms a Major Milestone Without Getting an Anime
content: Best known for Tokyo Ghoul , Sui Ishida is one of the most renowned manga creators in recent years. He is not only praised for his exceptional storytelling but also for his art style, which is one of a kind.
author: ComicBook

title: Chainsaw Man: The Assassins Arc Releases New Trailer
content: Studio MAPPA is firing on all engines as a part of its fifteenth anniversary celebration, with the production house already giving fans a look at the fourth season of Jujutsu Kaisen .
author: ComicBook

title: A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even TV Anime Reveals More Cast
content: The staff for the television anime of Metabo Hagure 's A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even: How I Crushed My Homeland with My Mighty Grimoires ( Buchigire Reijō wa Hōfuku wo Chikaimashita. Madōsho no Chikara de Sokoku wo Tataki Tsubushimasu ) light novel series revealed two more cast members on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Dorohedoro Anime's 3rd Season Reveals Teaser Video
content: The " MAPPA 15th Anniversary Lineup Reveal" livestream event on Friday revealed a teaser video for the third anime season based on Q Hayashida 's Dorohedoro manga. The second season was previously scheduled to debut in 2025.
author: ANN
